  422 | // ─── EXPORTACIÓN PDF (jsPDF + html2canvas) ────────────────────────────────────
  423 | async function exportarPDF(refEl, datos){
  424 |   try{
  425 |     const [h2c, jsPDF_mod] = await Promise.all([
  426 |       import("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js"),
  427 |       import("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"),
  428 |     ]);
  429 |     const html2canvas=h2c.default||h2c;
  430 |     const {jsPDF}=jsPDF_mod.default||jsPDF_mod;
  431 |     const canvas=await html2canvas(refEl,{scale:1.5,backgroundColor:"#07090F",useCORS:true});
  432 |     const imgData=canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg",0.92);
  433 |     const pdf=new jsPDF({orientation:"landscape",unit:"mm",format:"a3"});
  434 |     const pw=pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
